items.answer: Dan broke his leg while he was skiing.
items.audioText: Dan broke his leg while he was skiing.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Dan broke his leg
hints.en: The first half: Dan broke his leg

explanation.he: הפעולה הקצרה (שבירת הרגל) באה ב־Past Simple: broke. הפעולה הארוכה (skiing) ב־Past Progressive.
explanation.en: The short action uses the Past Simple: broke. The long action uses the Past Progressive: was skiing.

alternatives: While he was skiing, Dan broke his leg.

items.answer: When I was little, I used to be afraid of dogs.
items.audioText: When I was little, I used to be afraid of dogs.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: When I was little, I used
hints.en: The first half: When I was little, I used

explanation.he: used to + פועל בסיס = משהו שהיה נכון פעם, והיום כבר לא. במשפט חיובי כותבים used עם d.
explanation.en: used to + base verb = something true in the past, not now. In positive sentences write used with d.

alternatives: I used to be afraid of dogs when I was little.

items.answer: My grandfather used to smoke, but he stopped years ago.
items.audioText: My grandfather used to smoke, but he stopped years ago.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My grandfather used to smoke,
hints.en: The first half: My grandfather used to smoke,

explanation.he: used to = הרגל בעבר שכבר לא קיים. אין לו צורת הווה, ולכן אין uses to.
explanation.en: used to = a past habit that stopped. It has no present form, so there is no uses to.

items.answer: We didn't use to have a car. We walked everywhere.
items.audioText: We didn't use to have a car. We walked everywhere.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We didn't use to have
hints.en: The first half: We didn't use to have

explanation.he: אחרי didn't בא פועל בסיס, ולכן didn't use to, בלי d.
explanation.en: After didn't, use the base verb, so didn't use to, without d.

alternatives: We walked everywhere. We didn't use to have a car.

items.answer: Look at those dark clouds! It is going to rain.
items.audioText: Look at those dark clouds! It is going to rain.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Look at those dark clouds!
hints.en: The first half: Look at those dark clouds!

explanation.he: כשיש סימן עכשיו שמשהו יקרה, משתמשים ב־be going to + פועל בסיס: It is going to rain.
explanation.en: When there is a sign now, use be going to + base verb: It is going to rain.

alternatives: It is going to rain. Look at those dark clouds.

items.answer: Watch out! That glass is going to fall off the table.
items.audioText: Watch out! That glass is going to fall off the table.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Watch out! That glass is going
hints.en: The first half: Watch out! That glass is going

explanation.he: going to + פועל בסיס: is going to fall. רואים סימן עכשיו שזה יקרה.
explanation.en: going to + base verb: is going to fall. There is a sign now.

alternatives: That glass is going to fall off the table. Watch out.

items.answer: I'll call you when I get home.
items.audioText: I'll call you when I get home.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I'll call you when
hints.en: The first half: I'll call you when

explanation.he: אחרי when, as soon as, before, after, until שמדברים על עתיד משתמשים בהווה פשוט: when I get home. בעברית אומרים "כשאגיע" בעתיד, ולכן קל לטעות.
explanation.en: After when, as soon as, before, after and until about the future, use the Present Simple: when I get home.

alternatives: When I get home, I'll call you.

items.answer: As soon as she arrives, we will start dinner.
items.audioText: As soon as she arrives, we will start dinner.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: As soon as she arrives,
hints.en: The first half: As soon as she arrives,

explanation.he: אחרי as soon as בעתיד: Present Simple. she הוא גוף שלישי, ולכן arrives.
explanation.en: After as soon as about the future, use the Present Simple. With she: arrives.

alternatives: We will start dinner as soon as she arrives.

items.answer: When I finish my homework, I'll go out with my friends.
items.audioText: When I finish my homework, I'll go out with my friends.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: When I finish my homework, I'll
hints.en: The first half: When I finish my homework, I'll

explanation.he: When I finish..., I'll go out. אחרי when: הווה פשוט. בחלק השני: will.
explanation.en: When I finish..., I'll go out. Present Simple after when, will in the other part.

alternatives: I'll go out with my friends when I finish my homework.

items.answer: We'll wait here until the rain stops.
items.audioText: We'll wait here until the rain stops.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We'll wait here until
hints.en: The first half: We'll wait here until

explanation.he: until + Present Simple: until the rain stops.
explanation.en: until + Present Simple: until the rain stops.

alternatives: Until the rain stops, we'll wait here.

items.answer: I have seen that movie three times.
items.audioText: I have seen that movie three times.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I have seen that
hints.en: The first half: I have seen that

explanation.he: see → saw → seen. אחרי have: seen.
explanation.en: see → saw → seen. After have: seen.

items.answer: She has been to Paris twice.
items.audioText: She has been to Paris twice.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She has been

explanation.he: be → was / were → been. has been to = ביקרה ב.
explanation.en: be → was / were → been. has been to = has visited.

items.answer: We have already eaten lunch.
items.audioText: We have already eaten lunch.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: We have already

explanation.he: eat → ate → eaten. have already eaten.
explanation.en: eat → ate → eaten. have already eaten.

alternatives: We have eaten lunch already.

items.answer: Have you ever ridden a horse?
items.audioText: Have you ever ridden a horse?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Have you ever

explanation.he: ride → rode → ridden. Have you ever ridden...? = האם אי פעם רכבת?
explanation.en: ride → rode → ridden. Have you ever ridden...? asks about life experience.

items.answer: Oh no! He has lost his phone again!
items.audioText: Oh no! He has lost his phone again!

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Oh no! He has
hints.en: The first half: Oh no! He has

explanation.he: lose → lost → lost. has lost = איבד, והטלפון עדיין חסר.
explanation.en: lose → lost → lost. has lost: the phone is still missing.

alternatives: He has lost his phone again! Oh no!

items.answer: They have lived in this town since 2015.
items.audioText: They have lived in this town since 2015.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: They have lived in
hints.en: The first half: They have lived in

explanation.he: פועל רגיל: הצורה השלישית זהה לעבר. have lived. בעברית "הם גרים פה מאז 2015", באנגלית Present Perfect.
explanation.en: Regular verb: the third form is like the past. have lived. English uses the Present Perfect here.

alternatives: Since 2015, they have lived in this town.

items.answer: I have lived in Jerusalem for ten years.
items.audioText: I have lived in Jerusalem for ten years.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I have lived in
hints.en: The first half: I have lived in

explanation.he: for + משך זמן (for ten years). since + נקודת התחלה (since 2016).
explanation.en: for + a length of time (for ten years). since + a starting point (since 2016).

alternatives: For ten years, I have lived in Jerusalem.

items.answer: She has been my best friend since first grade.
items.audioText: She has been my best friend since first grade.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She has been my best
hints.en: The first half: She has been my best

explanation.he: since + נקודת התחלה: since first grade. בעברית "מאז כיתה א'".
explanation.en: since + starting point: since first grade.

alternatives: Since first grade, she has been my best friend.

items.answer: Have you finished your homework yet?
items.audioText: Have you finished your homework yet?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Have you finished

explanation.he: yet בא בסוף שאלות ושלילה: Have you finished yet? = כבר סיימת?
explanation.en: yet comes at the end of questions and negatives: Have you finished yet?

items.answer: I haven't cleaned my room yet.
items.audioText: I haven't cleaned my room yet.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I haven't cleaned

explanation.he: yet בשלילה = עדיין לא. already בא במשפט חיובי.
explanation.en: yet in negatives = not until now. already goes in positive sentences.

alternatives: I haven't yet cleaned my room.

items.answer: Don't make coffee for me. I have already had two cups.
items.audioText: Don't make coffee for me. I have already had two cups.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Don't make coffee for me. I
hints.en: The first half: Don't make coffee for me. I

explanation.he: already = כבר, במשפט חיובי, בין have לצורה השלישית: I have already had two cups.
explanation.en: already = before now, in positive sentences, between have and the verb.

alternatives: Don't make coffee for me. I have had two cups already.
I have already had two cups. Don't make coffee for me.
I have had two cups already. Don't make coffee for me.

items.answer: Have you ever been to Eilat?
items.audioText: Have you ever been to Eilat?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Have you ever

explanation.he: been בא אחרי have / has. עם you: Have you ever been...? = היית פעם ב...?
explanation.en: been follows have / has. With you: Have you ever been...?

items.answer: I have just finished the test. I'm so relieved!
items.audioText: I have just finished the test. I'm so relieved!

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I have just finished the
hints.en: The first half: I have just finished the

explanation.he: just = הרגע. I have just finished = סיימתי הרגע.
explanation.en: just = a very short time ago. I have just finished.

alternatives: I'm so relieved! I have just finished the test!

items.answer: This is the first time I have seen snow!
items.audioText: This is the first time I have seen snow!

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: This is the first time
hints.en: The first half: This is the first time

explanation.he: אחרי It's / This is the first time משתמשים ב־Present Perfect: This is the first time I have seen snow. בעברית אומרים "אני רואה".
explanation.en: After This is the first time, use the Present Perfect: the first time I have seen snow.

items.answer: My sister has gone to London. She'll be back next week.
items.audioText: My sister has gone to London. She'll be back next week.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My sister has gone to London.
hints.en: The first half: My sister has gone to London.

explanation.he: has gone to = נסע ועדיין שם. has been to = ביקר וחזר. היא חוזרת רק בשבוע הבא, ולכן has gone.
explanation.en: has gone to = went and is still there. has been to = visited and came back.

alternatives: My sister has gone to London. Next week she'll be back.

items.answer: I lost my wallet yesterday.
items.audioText: I lost my wallet yesterday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I lost my

explanation.he: עם yesterday, last week, ago משתמשים ב־Past Simple: I lost.
explanation.en: With yesterday, last week or ago, use the Past Simple: I lost.

alternatives: Yesterday I lost my wallet.

items.answer: We went to Greece in 2019.
items.audioText: We went to Greece in 2019.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: We went to

explanation.he: שנה מוגדרת בעבר = Past Simple: We went to Greece in 2019.
explanation.en: A finished year = Past Simple: We went to Greece in 2019.

alternatives: In 2019, we went to Greece.

items.answer: I haven't seen him since we finished school.
items.audioText: I haven't seen him since we finished school.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I haven't seen him
hints.en: The first half: I haven't seen him

explanation.he: since מחבר עבר להווה, ולכן Present Perfect: I haven't seen him since... בעברית "לא ראיתי אותו מאז" בעבר, אבל באנגלית צריך have.
explanation.en: since links the past to now, so use the Present Perfect: I haven't seen him since...

alternatives: Since we finished school, I haven't seen him.

items.answer: Shakespeare wrote many famous plays before he died in 1616.
items.audioText: Shakespeare wrote many famous plays before he died in 1616.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Shakespeare wrote many famous plays
hints.en: The first half: Shakespeare wrote many famous plays

explanation.he: כשהתקופה נגמרה (אדם שכבר לא בחיים), משתמשים ב־Past Simple: Shakespeare wrote.
explanation.en: When the period is over, use the Past Simple: Shakespeare wrote.

alternatives: Before he died in 1616, Shakespeare wrote many famous plays.

items.answer: When did you start learning English?
items.audioText: When did you start learning English?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: When did you

explanation.he: שאלה עם When על עבר: Past Simple. When did you start? לא שואלים When have you...
explanation.en: When about the past takes the Past Simple: When did you start?

items.answer: How many films have you watched so far this year?
items.audioText: How many films have you watched so far this year?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: How many films have you
hints.en: The first half: How many films have you

explanation.he: so far = עד עכשיו, ולכן Present Perfect: How many films have you watched so far?
explanation.en: so far = until now, so use the Present Perfect: How many films have you watched?

alternatives: How many films have you watched this year so far?
So far this year, how many films have you watched?
This year, how many films have you watched so far?

items.answer: She has been learning English for three years.
items.audioText: She has been learning English for three years.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She has been learning
hints.en: The first half: She has been learning

explanation.he: has been + ing: has been learning. הלימוד התחיל לפני שלוש שנים ועוד נמשך.
explanation.en: has been + -ing: has been learning. It started three years ago and continues.

alternatives: For three years, she has been learning English.

items.answer: How long have you been waiting here?
items.audioText: How long have you been waiting here?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: How long have you
hints.en: The first half: How long have you

explanation.he: How long have you been waiting? בעברית שואלים בהווה ("כמה זמן מחכים?"). באנגלית have been + ing.
explanation.en: How long have you been waiting? Hebrew uses the present; English uses have been + -ing.

alternatives: How long have you been here waiting?

items.answer: You look tired and you're all sweaty. Have you been running?
items.audioText: You look tired and you're all sweaty. Have you been running?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: You look tired and you're all
hints.en: The first half: You look tired and you're all

explanation.he: Present Perfect Progressive בשאלה: Have + you + been + ing.
explanation.en: Present Perfect Progressive question: Have + you + been + -ing.

alternatives: You're all sweaty and you look tired. Have you been running?

items.answer: We have known each other since kindergarten.
items.audioText: We have known each other since kindergarten.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We have known each
hints.en: The first half: We have known each

explanation.he: פעלי מצב (know, like, have במשמעות בעלות) בדרך כלל לא באים ב־ing. לכן Present Perfect רגיל: have known.
explanation.en: State verbs (know, like) are not usually used in the -ing form, so use the simple Present Perfect: have known.

alternatives: Since kindergarten, we have known each other.

items.answer: Before that trip, she had never seen such a tall building.
items.audioText: Before that trip, she had never seen such a tall building.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Before that trip, she had never
hints.en: The first half: Before that trip, she had never

explanation.he: had never seen = מעולם לא ראתה עד אותו זמן בעבר.
explanation.en: had never seen = never before that time in the past.

alternatives: She had never seen such a tall building before that trip.

items.answer: By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.
items.audioText: By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: By the time the police
hints.en: The first half: By the time the police

explanation.he: By the time + עבר: הפעולה האחרת כבר קרתה קודם. had escaped.
explanation.en: By the time + past: the other action happened earlier. had escaped.

alternatives: The thief had escaped by the time the police arrived.

items.answer: He was hungry because he hadn't eaten all day.
items.audioText: He was hungry because he hadn't eaten all day.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He was hungry because he
hints.en: The first half: He was hungry because he

explanation.he: hadn't eaten: הסיבה לרעב קרתה לפני כן.
explanation.en: hadn't eaten: the reason for the hunger came earlier.

alternatives: Because he hadn't eaten all day, he was hungry.

items.answer: I had seen the movie before, so I knew the ending.
items.audioText: I had seen the movie before, so I knew the ending.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I had seen the movie before,
hints.en: The first half: I had seen the movie before,

explanation.he: כשמספרים בעבר ומשהו קרה עוד קודם: had + צורה שלישית. had seen.
explanation.en: When telling about the past and something happened even earlier: had + third form. had seen.

items.answer: She was upset because her friends had forgotten her birthday.
items.audioText: She was upset because her friends had forgotten her birthday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She was upset because her
hints.en: The first half: She was upset because her

explanation.he: סיבה בעבר שקרתה לפני פעולה אחרת בעבר: had forgotten.
explanation.en: A past reason that happened before another past event: had forgotten.

alternatives: Because her friends had forgotten her birthday, she was upset.

items.answer: Had you ever been abroad before you moved to Israel?
items.audioText: Had you ever been abroad before you moved to Israel?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Had you ever been abroad
hints.en: The first half: Had you ever been abroad

explanation.he: ניסיון עד נקודה בעבר: Had + you + ever + been.
explanation.en: Experience up to a past point: Had you ever been...?

alternatives: Before you moved to Israel, had you ever been abroad?

items.answer: After she had finished her exams, she went on a trip.
items.audioText: After she had finished her exams, she went on a trip.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: After she had finished her exams,
hints.en: The first half: After she had finished her exams,

explanation.he: had + צורה שלישית לפעולה הראשונה: After she had finished... she went.
explanation.en: had + past participle for the first action: After she had finished... she went.

alternatives: She went on a trip after she had finished her exams.

items.answer: English is spoken in many countries.
items.audioText: English is spoken in many countries.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: English is spoken

explanation.he: כשהנושא מקבל את הפעולה, משתמשים בסביל: be + צורה שלישית. English is spoken.
explanation.en: When the subject receives the action, use the passive: be + past participle. English is spoken.

alternatives: In many countries, English is spoken.

items.answer: Hebrew is written from right to left.
items.audioText: Hebrew is written from right to left.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Hebrew is written from
hints.en: The first half: Hebrew is written from

explanation.he: סביל בהווה: is / are + צורה שלישית. Hebrew is written from right to left.
explanation.en: Present passive: is / are + past participle. Hebrew is written from right to left.

items.answer: This bridge was built in 1990.
items.audioText: This bridge was built in 1990.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: This bridge was

explanation.he: סביל בעבר: was / were + צורה שלישית. build → built → built.
explanation.en: Past passive: was / were + past participle. build → built → built.

alternatives: In 1990, this bridge was built.

items.answer: In the past, letters were written by hand.
items.audioText: In the past, letters were written by hand.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: In the past, letters
hints.en: The first half: In the past, letters

explanation.he: were + צורה שלישית: were written.
explanation.en: were + past participle: were written.

alternatives: Letters were written by hand in the past.

items.answer: Cheese is made from milk.
items.audioText: Cheese is made from milk.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Cheese is made

explanation.he: סביל בהווה: is made. made from = עשוי מ.
explanation.en: Present passive: is made. made from = produced from.

items.answer: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
items.audioText: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The Mona Lisa was painted
hints.en: The first half: The Mona Lisa was painted

explanation.he: בסביל, מי שעשה את הפעולה בא אחרי by. בעברית "על ידי", ולפעמים אומרים "מ", ולכן יש מי שכותב from.
explanation.en: In the passive, the doer comes after by.

items.answer: My bike was stolen last night!
items.audioText: My bike was stolen last night!

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My bike was

explanation.he: last night = עבר, ולכן was + צורה שלישית: was stolen. steal → stole → stolen.
explanation.en: last night = past, so was + past participle: was stolen.

alternatives: Last night my bike was stolen!

items.answer: Most of these phones are made in China.
items.audioText: Most of these phones are made in China.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Most of these phones
hints.en: The first half: Most of these phones

explanation.he: סביל ברבים בהווה: are + צורה שלישית. are made.
explanation.en: Plural present passive: are + past participle. are made.

items.answer: The results of the competition will be announced tomorrow morning.
items.audioText: The results of the competition will be announced tomorrow morning.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The results of the competition
hints.en: The first half: The results of the competition

explanation.he: סביל בעתיד: will be + צורה שלישית. will be announced.
explanation.en: Future passive: will be + past participle. will be announced.

alternatives: Tomorrow morning, the results of the competition will be announced.

items.answer: The project must be finished by Sunday.
items.audioText: The project must be finished by Sunday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The project must be
hints.en: The first half: The project must be

explanation.he: סביל עם מודאל: must / can / should + be + צורה שלישית. must be finished.
explanation.en: Passive with a modal: must / can / should + be + past participle. must be finished.

alternatives: By Sunday, the project must be finished.

items.answer: The car hasn't been washed yet. It's still dirty.
items.audioText: The car hasn't been washed yet. It's still dirty.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The car hasn't been washed
hints.en: The first half: The car hasn't been washed

explanation.he: סביל ב־Present Perfect: has / have + been + צורה שלישית. hasn't been washed.
explanation.en: Present Perfect passive: has / have + been + past participle. hasn't been washed.

alternatives: The car hasn't yet been washed. It's still dirty.

items.answer: Three new computers have been added to our library this month.
items.audioText: Three new computers have been added to our library this month.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Three new computers have been added
hints.en: The first half: Three new computers have been added

explanation.he: have been added: סביל ב־Present Perfect. this month עוד לא נגמר.
explanation.en: have been added: Present Perfect passive. this month is not over.

alternatives: This month, three new computers have been added to our library.

items.answer: The meeting has been postponed until next week.
items.audioText: The meeting has been postponed until next week.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The meeting has been
hints.en: The first half: The meeting has been

explanation.he: has been postponed = נדחתה. סביל ב־Present Perfect.
explanation.en: has been postponed: Present Perfect passive.

items.answer: Can you look after my dog while I'm on holiday?
items.audioText: Can you look after my dog while I'm on holiday?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Can you look after my
hints.en: The first half: Can you look after my

explanation.he: look after = לשמור על, לטפל ב. look for = לחפש. look up = לחפש מידע.
explanation.en: look after = take care of. look for = search.

alternatives: While I'm on holiday, can you look after my dog?

items.answer: I get along with my classmates. We never argue.
items.audioText: I get along with my classmates. We never argue.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I get along with my
hints.en: The first half: I get along with my

explanation.he: get along with = להסתדר עם. get over = להתגבר על. get away with = לצאת בלי עונש.
explanation.en: get along with = have a good relationship with.

alternatives: We never argue. I get along with my classmates.

items.answer: I'm really looking forward to the summer holidays.
items.audioText: I'm really looking forward to the summer holidays.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I'm really looking forward
hints.en: The first half: I'm really looking forward

explanation.he: look forward to = לחכות בקוצר רוח, לצפות בשמחה למשהו. אחרי to בא שם עצם או ing.
explanation.en: look forward to = wait happily for. After it: a noun or -ing.

items.answer: Sorry for interrupting. Please carry on with your story.
items.audioText: Sorry for interrupting. Please carry on with your story.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Sorry for interrupting. Please carry
hints.en: The first half: Sorry for interrupting. Please carry

explanation.he: carry on = להמשיך. carry out = לבצע (משימה, ניסוי).
explanation.en: carry on = continue. carry out = do a task.

alternatives: Please carry on with your story. Sorry for interrupting.
Sorry for interrupting. Carry on with your story, please.
Carry on with your story, please. Sorry for interrupting.

items.answer: I can't figure out how this new app works.
items.audioText: I can't figure out how this new app works.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I can't figure out how
hints.en: The first half: I can't figure out how

explanation.he: figure out = להבין, לפענח. give out = לחלק. put out = לכבות.
explanation.en: figure out = understand after thinking.

items.answer: The doctor told him to cut down on sugar.
items.audioText: The doctor told him to cut down on sugar.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The doctor told him to
hints.en: The first half: The doctor told him to

explanation.he: cut down on = להפחית. cut up = לחתוך לחתיכות. cut in = להתפרץ לשיחה.
explanation.en: cut down on = have less of.

items.answer: The match was called off because of the storm.
items.audioText: The match was called off because of the storm.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The match was called off
hints.en: The first half: The match was called off

explanation.he: call off = לבטל. call back = להתקשר בחזרה. call up = להתקשר, לגייס.
explanation.en: call off = cancel.

alternatives: Because of the storm, the match was called off.

items.answer: My mother's sister is my aunt.
items.audioText: My mother's sister is my aunt.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My mother's sister

explanation.he: אחות של אמא או של אבא היא aunt (דודה). uncle הוא דוד (גבר). cousin הוא בן דוד או בת דודה.
explanation.en: Your mother's or father's sister is your aunt. An uncle is a man. A cousin is your aunt's or uncle's child.

alternatives: My aunt is my mother's sister.

items.answer: I didn't eat breakfast, so I'm very hungry now.
items.audioText: I didn't eat breakfast, so I'm very hungry now.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I didn't eat breakfast, so
hints.en: The first half: I didn't eat breakfast, so

explanation.he: מי שלא אכל הוא רעב: hungry. thirsty זה צמא (לשתייה). full זה שבע, ההפך.
explanation.en: If you didn't eat, you are hungry. thirsty is for drinks. full is the opposite.

alternatives: I didn't eat breakfast, so now I'm very hungry.

items.answer: I can't remember her name. What is it again?
items.audioText: I can't remember her name. What is it again?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I can't remember her name.
hints.en: The first half: I can't remember her name.

explanation.he: remember = לזכור. remind = להזכיר למישהו אחר. מי ששואל What is it again לא מצליח לזכור.
explanation.en: remember = keep in mind. remind = help someone else remember. The speaker can't remember the name.

alternatives: I can't remember it. What is her name again?

items.answer: My little sister is learning to ride a bike.
items.audioText: My little sister is learning to ride a bike.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My little sister is learning
hints.en: The first half: My little sister is learning

explanation.he: learn = ללמוד, לקבל ידע. teach = ללמד מישהו אחר. אחותי לומדת לרכוב: She is learning to ride a bike.
explanation.en: learn = get a skill. teach = give it to someone. The sister is learning to ride.

items.answer: Hurry up! We're going to be late for school.
items.audioText: Hurry up! We're going to be late for school.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Hurry up! We're going to
hints.en: The first half: Hurry up! We're going to

explanation.he: ממהרים כי לא רוצים לאחר: be late for school. early זה מוקדם, ואז לא צריך למהר.
explanation.en: We hurry because we don't want to be late. If we were early, we wouldn't need to hurry.

alternatives: We're going to be late for school. Hurry up.

items.answer: I see my grandparents very often because they live next door.
items.audioText: I see my grandparents very often because they live next door.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I see my grandparents very often
hints.en: The first half: I see my grandparents very often

explanation.he: מי שגר בבית הסמוך רואים אותו הרבה: very often. never זה אף פעם, ו־ago בא אחרי זמן (two years ago).
explanation.en: If they live next door, you see them very often. never is the opposite, and ago comes after a time (two years ago).

alternatives: Because they live next door, I see my grandparents very often.
I very often see my grandparents because they live next door.

items.answer: The flight to London takes five hours.
items.audioText: The flight to London takes five hours.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The flight to London
hints.en: The first half: The flight to London

explanation.he: משך זמן נמדד ב־hours (שעות). clock זה שעון קיר ו־watch זה שעון יד.
explanation.en: We measure time in hours. A clock and a watch are things that show the time.

items.answer: Take an umbrella. The rain is very heavy today.
items.audioText: Take an umbrella. The rain is very heavy today.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Take an umbrella. The rain
hints.en: The first half: Take an umbrella. The rain

explanation.he: לוקחים מטרייה כשיורד גשם. heavy rain זה גשם חזק.
explanation.en: You take an umbrella for the rain. Heavy rain = a lot of rain.

alternatives: The rain is very heavy today. Take an umbrella.
Take an umbrella. Today the rain is very heavy.
Today the rain is very heavy. Take an umbrella.

items.answer: I fell off my bike and now my knee hurts.
items.audioText: I fell off my bike and now my knee hurts.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I fell off my bike
hints.en: The first half: I fell off my bike

explanation.he: אחרי נפילה הברך כואבת: my knee hurts. הברך לא ישנה (sleeps) ולא צוחקת (laughs).
explanation.en: After a fall, your knee hurts.

items.answer: I can't buy these shoes. They are too expensive.
items.audioText: I can't buy these shoes. They are too expensive.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I can't buy these shoes.
hints.en: The first half: I can't buy these shoes.

explanation.he: אי אפשר לקנות כי הן עולות הרבה כסף: too expensive. cheap זה זול ו־free זה בחינם.
explanation.en: The shoes cost too much money, so they are too expensive.

items.answer: The bus is cheap. A ticket costs only five shekels.
items.audioText: The bus is cheap. A ticket costs only five shekels.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The bus is cheap. A
hints.en: The first half: The bus is cheap. A

explanation.he: כרטיס שעולה רק חמישה שקלים הוא זול: cheap. expensive זה ההפך.
explanation.en: A ticket for only five shekels is cheap, not expensive.

alternatives: The bus is cheap. A ticket only costs five shekels.
A ticket costs only five shekels. The bus is cheap.
A ticket only costs five shekels. The bus is cheap.

items.answer: How much did you pay for that jacket?
items.audioText: How much did you pay for that jacket?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: How much did you
hints.en: The first half: How much did you

explanation.he: pay for = לשלם על. cost לא מתאים לאדם (The jacket cost 100). sell לא מתאים כי הוא צריך מושא: How much did you sell it for?
explanation.en: We say pay for something. cost needs the thing as subject: The jacket cost 100. sell needs an object: sell it for.

items.answer: How was your trip to Eilat?
items.audioText: How was your trip to Eilat?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: How was your

explanation.he: על נסיעה אחת אומרים a trip: How was your trip? travel הוא בעיקר פועל (I love to travel). road זה כביש.
explanation.en: For one journey, say trip. travel is mostly a verb, and a road is a street.

items.answer: Many people are afraid of snakes.
items.audioText: Many people are afraid of snakes.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Many people are

explanation.he: afraid of = מפחד מ. אנשים רבים מפחדים מנחשים. hungry ו־ready לא באים עם of.
explanation.en: afraid of = scared of. hungry and ready don't go with of.

items.answer: This movie is so long and slow. I'm bored.
items.audioText: This movie is so long and slow. I'm bored.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: This movie is so long
hints.en: The first half: This movie is so long

explanation.he: I'm bored = אני משועמם/ת. The movie is boring = הסרט משעמם. על התחושה של אדם: ed.
explanation.en: I'm bored describes my feeling. The movie is boring describes the movie.

alternatives: This movie is so slow and long. I'm bored.
I'm bored. This movie is so long and slow.
I'm bored. This movie is so slow and long.

items.answer: I'm worried about the test tomorrow. I didn't study.
items.audioText: I'm worried about the test tomorrow. I didn't study.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I'm worried about the test
hints.en: The first half: I'm worried about the test

explanation.he: מי שלא למד למבחן מודאג: worried about. proud זה גאה, ולא מתאים למי שלא למד.
explanation.en: If you didn't study, you are worried about the test.

alternatives: I didn't study. I'm worried about the test tomorrow.

items.answer: I don't have a pencil. Can you lend me one?
items.audioText: I don't have a pencil. Can you lend me one?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I don't have a pencil.
hints.en: The first half: I don't have a pencil.

explanation.he: החבר/ה נותן/ת לי עיפרון לזמן קצר: lend me. borrow זה לקחת: Can I borrow your pencil?
explanation.en: The friend gives me the pencil, so lend me. With borrow we say: Can I borrow your pencil?

items.answer: The library is a quiet place. People read and study there.
items.audioText: The library is a quiet place. People read and study there.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The library is a quiet place.
hints.en: The first half: The library is a quiet place.

explanation.he: ספרייה היא מקום שקט: quiet. noisy ו־loud זה רועש.
explanation.en: A library is a quiet place. noisy and loud are the opposite.

alternatives: The library is a quiet place. People study and read there.
The library is a quiet place. There people read and study.

items.answer: Don't play near the road. It's dangerous.
items.audioText: Don't play near the road. It's dangerous.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Don't play near the
hints.en: The first half: Don't play near the

explanation.he: ליד הכביש מסוכן: dangerous. safe זה בטוח. careful מתאר אדם זהיר, לא מקום.
explanation.en: A road is dangerous. safe is the opposite. careful describes a person, not a place.

alternatives: It's dangerous. Don't play near the road.

items.answer: There is nothing in the box. It's empty.
items.audioText: There is nothing in the box. It's empty.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: There is nothing in
hints.en: The first half: There is nothing in

explanation.he: קופסה שאין בה כלום היא ריקה: empty. full זה מלא, ההפך.
explanation.en: A box with nothing in it is empty. full is the opposite.

alternatives: It's empty. There is nothing in the box.

items.answer: We're late, so we have to walk quickly.
items.audioText: We're late, so we have to walk quickly.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We're late, so we
hints.en: The first half: We're late, so we

explanation.he: כשמאחרים הולכים מהר: walk quickly. slowly זה לאט, ההפך.
explanation.en: When you are late, you walk quickly, not slowly.

items.answer: My friends and I play football together every Friday.
items.audioText: My friends and I play football together every Friday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My friends and I play
hints.en: The first half: My friends and I play

explanation.he: אני והחברים משחקים ביחד: together. alone זה לבד, ו־apart זה בנפרד.
explanation.en: My friends and I play together. alone and apart mean not with others.

alternatives: Every Friday, my friends and I play football together.

items.answer: Too much screen time can affect how well you sleep.
items.audioText: Too much screen time can affect how well you sleep.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Too much screen time can
hints.en: The first half: Too much screen time can

explanation.he: affect = להשפיע על. מסכים משפיעים על איכות השינה. avoid = להימנע, admit = להודות, refuse = לסרב. אף אחד מהם לא מתאים כאן.
explanation.en: affect = have an influence on. Screens influence how well you sleep.

items.answer: He left home early to avoid the heavy traffic.
items.audioText: He left home early to avoid the heavy traffic.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He left home early to
hints.en: The first half: He left home early to

explanation.he: avoid = להימנע מ. יוצאים מוקדם כדי לא להיתקע בפקק. בעברית אומרים "להימנע מ", ובאנגלית אין מילת יחס: avoid the traffic.
explanation.en: avoid = stay away from something. He left early so he would not be stuck in traffic.

alternatives: To avoid the heavy traffic, he left home early.

items.answer: My teacher suggested that I read one English book a month.
items.audioText: My teacher suggested that I read one English book a month.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My teacher suggested that I read
hints.en: The first half: My teacher suggested that I read

explanation.he: suggest = להציע רעיון. אחרי suggest אפשר להוסיף that ומשפט. refused, avoided ו־prevented לא באים כך עם that.
explanation.en: suggest = give an idea. We can say suggest that + a sentence.

items.answer: A helmet can prevent serious head injuries.
items.audioText: A helmet can prevent serious head injuries.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: A helmet can prevent
hints.en: The first half: A helmet can prevent

explanation.he: prevent = למנוע. קסדה מונעת פגיעות ראש. כדאי לא להתבלבל עם avoid (להימנע), שבו האדם עצמו מתרחק ממשהו.
explanation.en: prevent = stop something from happening. A helmet stops head injuries.

items.answer: Wear sunglasses to protect your eyes from the strong sun.
items.audioText: Wear sunglasses to protect your eyes from the strong sun.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Wear sunglasses to protect your
hints.en: The first half: Wear sunglasses to protect your

explanation.he: protect = להגן על. המבנה הוא protect something from something. בעברית "להגן על", באנגלית בלי on.
explanation.en: protect = keep safe. We say protect your eyes from the sun.

alternatives: To protect your eyes from the strong sun, wear sunglasses.

items.answer: Good coaches encourage their players to keep trying after a loss.
items.audioText: Good coaches encourage their players to keep trying after a loss.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Good coaches encourage their players to
hints.en: The first half: Good coaches encourage their players to

explanation.he: encourage = לעודד. המבנה: encourage someone to do something. prevent בא עם from ולא עם to.
explanation.en: encourage = give someone support to do something: encourage someone to do something.

alternatives: After a loss, good coaches encourage their players to keep trying.

items.answer: She finally admitted that she had forgotten to do her homework.
items.audioText: She finally admitted that she had forgotten to do her homework.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She finally admitted that she had
hints.en: The first half: She finally admitted that she had

explanation.he: admit = להודות שעשינו משהו לא טוב. כדאי לשים לב: "להודות" במובן thank זו מילה אחרת.
explanation.en: admit = say that something bad or embarrassing is true.

alternatives: Finally, she admitted that she had forgotten to do her homework.

items.answer: The little boy refused to eat his vegetables.
items.audioText: The little boy refused to eat his vegetables.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The little boy refused
hints.en: The first half: The little boy refused

explanation.he: refuse to do = לסרב לעשות. avoid בא עם ing: avoided eating. לכן avoided to eat שגוי.
explanation.en: refuse + to + verb. avoid takes -ing (avoided eating), so avoided to eat is wrong.

items.answer: Whether we go to the beach depends on the weather.
items.audioText: Whether we go to the beach depends on the weather.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Whether we go to the
hints.en: The first half: Whether we go to the

explanation.he: depend on = להיות תלוי ב. אומרים depends on, ולא affects on. affect בא בלי מילת יחס.
explanation.en: depend on = be decided by. affect never takes on.

items.answer: Only a few trees survived the big fire in the forest.
items.audioText: Only a few trees survived the big fire in the forest.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Only a few trees survived the
hints.en: The first half: Only a few trees survived the

explanation.he: survive = לשרוד, להישאר בחיים אחרי משהו קשה. באנגלית אומרים survive the fire, בלי מילת יחס.
explanation.en: survive = stay alive after something dangerous.

alternatives: In the forest, only a few trees survived the big fire.

items.answer: The flood caused serious damage to the roads.
items.audioText: The flood caused serious damage to the roads.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The flood caused serious
hints.en: The first half: The flood caused serious

explanation.he: damage = נזק. cause damage to = לגרום נזק ל. באנגלית damage היא מילה לא ספירה: לא אומרים a damage.
explanation.en: damage = harm to things. We say cause damage to something.

items.answer: Bright colors attract bees to the flowers.
items.audioText: Bright colors attract bees to the flowers.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Bright colors attract bees
hints.en: The first half: Bright colors attract bees

explanation.he: attract = למשוך. צבעים חזקים מושכים דבורות. attract X to Y = למשוך את X אל Y.
explanation.en: attract = make something come closer. Colors bring bees to flowers.

alternatives: Bright colors attract the bees to flowers.

items.answer: Factories and cars are major causes of air pollution.
items.audioText: Factories and cars are major causes of air pollution.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words
